title_en: Visions of the Future (13/20): Flying Cars and Domed Cities
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb so the sentence can say what happens to it: 动画片《杰森一家》把这种想象变成了经典形象 "The Jetsons turned these fantasies into classic images." English simply says "turn X into Y," but in Chinese a verb with a result like 变成 (become) or 想象成 (imagine as) usually needs 把: 把城市想象成…可以移动的有机体 "imagine cities as organisms that can move."
